items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Gerald bought a bass on a Wednesday and played his first job on Thursday.

ctx.x: There's a lot of children that way, especially here in New Orleans, where they've heard all of this music all their life and have that background. A lot of them do it with very, very special.
Gerald bought a bass on a Wednesday and played his first job on Thursday. Oh, really?
And he played a little bit on the piano or anything else?
